_: What the King can do about a piece of news (news_actions.gd; Crusader Kings 3's alert with its answers, Warcraft III's 'our town is under attack'). kinds: a news kind (the chronicle's kind, or 'attack' for a foe's host on one of the King's towns, which news_actions.gd sees in the realm itself) -> its verbs, left to right; any other kind takes 'other'. Each verb is an order the King already has (a host order, a decree, the court, the tithe), never a new one; a verb with 'decree' in its row is that decree, placed by its row (at: town|seat; town: mine|theirs|any; not_seat; building + built_as, offered only where the town lacks it; unsworn: only a house not sworn to the crown), and one with 'ui' is the King's own control (ui.gd counsel_act: court, tithe_down, tithe_up). Every kind that reaches the news has at least one answer; notice: the kinds that are the King's own doings told back, or the year's turn, with nothing to decide (they keep only Go there): defend (the nearest free royal host garrisons the town: POST /host/order through host_command.gd), levy (the decree 'Raise the royal levy', mustered at Kingsmere), grain (the decree 'relief'), feast (the decree 'feast' in the town's lord's honour), rule (opens its matter at court), go (the camera to the town; Space or Home brings it back). A verb shows only where it fits (defend and levy at the King's own towns, grain and feast at a town, rule when a matter waits). verbs: each verb's words; its price is the bridge's (decrees.json via /world). free_orders: the orders a royal host may be taken from to defend. attack_hold: how long a threat's line stays in the corner, seconds (other lines: the ticker's 14). threat_words: the line for each threat ({house}, {town}). The kinds also cover the scenes the camera captions (scene_kinds.gd: siege, storm, razed, famine, plague...): a caption over a scene carries the same row (news_chips.gd caption). relief: the decree 'relief' as for grain, named for a sickness. caption_seconds: how long a caption with answers stays up.
